description: Operational benchmark dashboard for end-to-end performance, client behavior, ingestion throughput, and system resource utilization.

panels.description: Wall-clock benchmark duration by adapter and scenario.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "test_duration_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scale_factor"] =~ /^${scale_factor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${outcome}" == "All" or r["outcome"] == "${outcome}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${etl_type}" == "All" or r["etl_type"] == "${etl_type}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${is_bootstrap}" == "All" or (exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "${is_bootstrap}"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${spice_ref_name}" == "All" or (exists r["spice_ref_name"] and r["spice_ref_name"] == "${spice_ref_name}"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
      legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - SF" + (if exists r["scale_factor"] then r["scale_factor"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["etl_type"] then r["etl_type"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["outcome"] then r["outcome"] else "?") + (if exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "true" then "/bootstrap" else "")
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["legend"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

panels.title: Throughput (QPH)

panels.description: 99th percentile end-to-end request latency.

targets.query:
old = from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "e2e_latency_ms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scale_factor"] =~ /^${scale_factor:regex}$/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${outcome}" == "All" or r["outcome"] == "${outcome}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${etl_type}" == "All" or r["etl_type"] == "${etl_type}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${is_bootstrap}" == "All" or (exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "${is_bootstrap}"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${spice_ref_name}" == "All" or (exists r["spice_ref_name"] and r["spice_ref_name"] == "${spice_ref_name}"))
    |> toFloat()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - SF" + (if exists r["scale_factor"] then r["scale_factor"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["etl_type"] then r["etl_type"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["outcome"] then r["outcome"] else "?") + (if exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "true" then "/bootstrap" else "") }))
    |> group(columns: ["legend"])
    |> window(every: 5m)
    |> quantile(q: 0.99, method: "estimate_tdigest")
    |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
    |> window(every: inf)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])
    |> group(columns: ["legend"])

  new = from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "e2e_latency_gauge_ms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "gauge")          // single value field — no bucket/count/sum grab-bag
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scale_factor"] =~ /^${scale_factor:regex}$/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${outcome}" == "All" or r["outcome"] == "${outcome}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${etl_type}" == "All" or r["etl_type"] == "${etl_type}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${is_bootstrap}" == "All" or (exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "${is_bootstrap}"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${spice_ref_name}" == "All" or (exists r["spice_ref_name"] and r["spice_ref_name"] == "${spice_ref_name}"))
    |> toFloat()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - SF" + (if exists r["scale_factor"] then r["scale_factor"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["etl_type"] then r["etl_type"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["outcome"] then r["outcome"] else "?") + (if exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "true" then "/bootstrap" else "") }))
    |> group(columns: ["legend"])
    |> window(every: 5m)
    |> tail(n: 1)
    |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
    |> window(every: inf)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])
    |> group(columns: ["legend"])

  union(tables: [old, new])
    |> group(columns: ["legend"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

targets.query:
from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
     |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
     |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
     |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "query_queue_duration_ms")
     |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["adapter_name"])
     |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scenario"] =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
     |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scale_factor"] =~ /^${scale_factor:regex}$/)
     |> filter(fn: (r) => "${outcome}" == "All" or (exists r["outcome"] and r["outcome"] == "${outcome}"))
     |> filter(fn: (r) => "${etl_type}" == "All" or (exists r["etl_type"] and r["etl_type"] == "${etl_type}"))
     |> filter(fn: (r) => "${is_bootstrap}" == "All" or (exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "${is_bootstrap}"))
     |> filter(fn: (r) => "${spice_ref_name}" == "All" or (exists r["spice_ref_name"] and r["spice_ref_name"] == "${spice_ref_name}"))
     |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] != "count" and r["_field"] != "sum")
     |> toFloat()
     |> map(fn: (r) => ({
         r with
         le: if r["_field"] == "+Inf" then 10000000.0 else float(v: r["_field"])
       }))
     |> group(columns: ["adapter_name", "scenario", "scale_factor", "etl_type", "is_bootstrap", "_time", "le"])
     |> sum()
     |> group(columns: ["adapter_name", "scenario", "scale_factor", "etl_type", "is_bootstrap", "_time"])
     |> sort(columns: ["le"])
     |> cumulativeSum()
     |> histogramQuantile(quantile: 0.99)
     |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - SF" + (if exists r["scale_factor"] then r["scale_factor"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["etl_type"] then r["etl_type"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["outcome"] then r["outcome"] else "?") + (if exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "true" then "/bootstrap" else "")}))
     |> group(columns: ["legend"])
     |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
     |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])

targets.query:
qualifying_run_ids = from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["run_id"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${outcome}" == "All" or (exists r["outcome"] and r["outcome"] == "${outcome}"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${etl_type}" == "All" or (exists r["etl_type"] and r["etl_type"] == "${etl_type}"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${is_bootstrap}" == "All" or (exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "${is_bootstrap}"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => "${spice_ref_name}" == "All" or (exists r["spice_ref_name"] and r["spice_ref_name"] == "${spice_ref_name}"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["scale_factor"] =~ /^${scale_factor:regex}$/)
    |> keep(columns: ["run_id"])
    |> group()
    |> distinct(column: "run_id")
    |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

  total = (m) =>
    from(bucket: "benchmarks-telemetry")
      |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["type"] == "spicebench")
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == m)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r["run_id"], set: qualifying_run_ids))
      |> group(columns: ["run_id", "adapter_name", "scenario", "table", "scale_factor", "etl_type", "is_bootstrap"])
      |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)   // cumulative per table
      |> group(columns: ["run_id", "adapter_name", "scenario", "scale_factor", "etl_type", "is_bootstrap"])
      |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)    // total cumulative across tables

  wait  = total(m: "sut_cdc_source_wait_ms")
  apply = total(m: "sut_cdc_apply_ms")

  join(tables: {wait: wait, apply: apply}, on: ["_time", "run_id", "adapter_name", "scenario", "scale_factor", "etl_type", "is_bootstrap"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
        _value: if (r._value_wait + r._value_apply) > 0.0 then 100.0 * r._value_wait / (r._value_wait + r._value_apply) else 0.0,
        legend: r["adapter_name"] + " - SF" + (if exists r["scale_factor"] then r["scale_factor"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["etl_type"] then r["etl_type"] else "?") + "/" + (if exists r["outcome"] then r["outcome"] else "?") + (if exists r["is_bootstrap"] and r["is_bootstrap"] == "true" then "/bootstrap" else "") + " - " + r["run_id"]
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["legend"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "legend"])
